captions.detailed: A slant-top casino cabinet featuring an angled upper screen display, a forward-projecting button deck, and a lower belly door. The entire cabinet is finished in a uniform light gray color. In terms of articulation, the lower belly door rotates on a vertical side hinge, a circular spin button on the control deck moves up and down prismatically within its sleeve, and a small cylindrical volume dial near the bottom-right of the screen rotates continuously around its central shaft.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a slant-top casino gaming machine. The cabinet should include an angled upper screen frame, a protruding button deck with a cylindrical spin button, and a lower compartment with a hinged belly door. Ensure the belly door has a revolute joint, the spin button has a prismatic sliding joint, and a small volume knob near the screen has a continuous rotational joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main cabinet body using a 2D profile sketch with angled segments extruded laterally. Create the belly door as a flat plate recessed into the lower front face, and attach it to the cabinet using a revolute joint. Model the button deck's spin button as a cylinder nested in a slightly larger cylindrical sleeve, defining a prismatic joint along its vertical axis. Finally, model the volume knob as a small cylinder near the screen's bottom corner, and attach it to the cabinet via a continuous rotational joint.
